PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos: 02, 09, 15, 16, 26, 27, 34, 50, 60, 71, 74, 80, 87, 101, 104, 108, 109, 110, 112, 121, 122, 123, 127, 129, 130, 135, 136 and 138 of Block 05, contained in the Ca-dastral Map No. 910023, situated in the Village of Thirunelvely West, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. J/110 Thirunelvely West in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Nallur, in the District of Jaffna, in the Province of Northern, referred to in Notice No. 91/0012 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2021/09 of 30th May, 2017 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura” Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla 20th June, 2017
